Palmyra, or 8 miles west of East Troy, moving east at 35 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts up to 40 mph and penny size hail.

unsecured objects. Minor hail damage to vegetation is
possible.

Elkhorn, Union Grove, East Troy, Wind Lake, Rochester, Browns Lake,
Waterford North, Potter Lake, Eagle Lake, Burlington, Waterford, La
Grange, Honey Creek, Abells Corners, Tibbets, Millard, Kansasville,
North Cape, and Troy Center.

Interstate 43 between mile markers 30 and 42.

At 1002 AM CDT, a severe thunderstorm capable of producing a tornado
was located 7 miles southwest of Carter, or 19 miles southeast of
Crandon, moving southeast at 45 mph.

HAZARD...Tornado and quarter size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated rotation.

IMPACT...Flying debris will be dangerous to those caught without
shelter. Mobile homes will be damaged or destroyed. Damage
to roofs, windows and vehicles will occur. Tree damage is
likely.

Other locations impacted by the tornado include Freeman and Boot Lake
Campground.
